sn36.14:1.2: uppajjati → uppajjanti (bj) | uppajjati dukkhāpi → uppajanti dukkhā pi (pts) | uppajjati adukkhamasukhāpi → uppajjanti adukkhamasukhā pi (pts) | uppajanti → B1-2 uppajjati, as before, here and further on (pts note)
sn36.14:1.3: sāmisāpi → nirāmisā pi (pts) | uppajjati sāmisāpi → uppajjanti nirāmisā pi (pts) | uppajjantīti → In this paragraph S1-3 intermingle sāmisā nirāmisā in this manner: sāmisā pi sukhā- || nirāmisā pi sukhā- || samisā pi dukkhā- || nirāmisā pi dukkhā- etc. (pts note)
